data_class.description: Data class from the PRD (section 7). measured: observed by an instrument. reanalysis: output of a physical model fed with observations, with no projection into the future. extrapolated: an observed trend carried forward. approximated: estimated with archetypes or indirect indicators. illustrative: an example with no data value. The interface maps it to its label.

evidence_level.description: Evidence ladder: E0 described, E1 trend, E2 coincidence in time and place, E3 association, E4 exceptional against placebos, E5 coherent chain. No level allows causal verbs.

frame.description: Link of the frame that joins the sources: driver, pressure, state, exposure, response.

design.description: whatif: what a catalog archetype would ask for of a resource at a quantity the person assumes, next to the state of the place (from 14 November).

report_style.description: The three report formats built from one analysis.

support.description: Real size of what was measured. Grids are never mixed without resampling to the coarsest one.

until.description: Last year with data; absent means ongoing

cells.description: Grid cells inside the zone; 1 or fewer means the cell is larger than the zone

text.description: Text by language code. English is required; other languages are optional.

bbox.description: west, south, east, north in EPSG:4326

source_ref.description: Where a figure comes from, with what is needed to open it in one click.

absence.description: Missing data carries a reason. Never zero and never an invented value.
